name: Wave Paraphonic
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Four wavetable voices play the active Plaits chord table over Braids' 33-wave scan line, with per-voice wave fan and continuous interval scaling.

controls.label: Chord
controls.description: Selects a position in the active chord table.

controls.label: Wave
controls.description: Scans the 33-wave line all four voices read, crossfading between neighbours.

controls.label: Fan
controls.description: Offsets each voice further along the scan line, so the four read different waves.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Scales every table interval, from a unison at zero through the table verbatim at noon to double width.

outputs.main: The four voices summed, as the module has them.
outputs.aux: The chord table's first voice on its own.
